question.text: Which of the following persons is NOT eligible to deal in securities listed in the IFSC as per SEBI guidelines?

answer.text: A resident Indian individual not eligible under FEMA to invest offshore
A person not resident in India
A financial institution resident in India eligible under FEMA for outward investment

explanation.text: The Logic: Eligible IFSC securities participants are: (1) persons not resident in India, (2) NRIs, (3) FEMA-eligible resident financial institutions, and (4) resident individuals eligible under FEMA's Liberalized Remittance Scheme. A resident individual who is not FEMA-eligible does not qualify. The Trap: Resident Indians can participate, but only to the extent allowed under FEMA/LRS and subject to any Board-specified minimum investment; FEMA eligibility is the key qualifier, not residency alone. Note: Page 30 supports the eligible-participant list and the FEMA/LRS qualifier; the specific USD 250,000 annual LRS threshold is not stated in the workbook page checked.
